blocks.arabic_text: مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَغْدُوَ مَعَ أَصْحَابِكَ؟ فَقَالَ: أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ مَعَكَ ثُمَّ اَلْحَقَهُمْ، فَقَالَ: لَوْ أَنْفَقْتَ مَا فِي اْلاَرْضِ جَمِيعاً مَا أَدْرَكْتَ فَضْلَ غَدْوَتِهِمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث غريب، باب ما جاء في السفر يوم الجمعة، رقم:٥٢٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates, “The Prophet ﷺ sent Hazrat Abdullah ibn Rawahah (RA) out with a Jama'ah. That day was the day of Jumu'ah, and all the companions of Hazrat Abdullah ibn Rawahah (RA) set out early in the morning. Hazrat Abdullah ibn Rawahah (RA) stayed behind, intending to pray Jumu'ah with Rasulullah ﷺ and then join his companions. When he had finished praying Jumu'ah with the Prophet ﷺ, Rasulullah ﷺ saw him. The Prophet ﷺ asked, “Why did you stay behind instead of going with your companions in the morning?” He replied, “I wished to pray Jumu'ah with you, then set out and join them.” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Even if you spent everything on the earth, you could not attain the like of the reward of your companions who went out in the morning.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ بِسَرِيَّةٍ تَخْرُجُ، فَقَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، أَنَخْرُجُ اللَّيْلَةَ أَمْ نَمْكُثُ حَتَّي نُصْبِحَ؟ فَقَالَ: أَوَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَنْ تَبِيتُوا فِي خَرِيفٍ مِنْ خَرَائِفِ الْجَنَّةِ وَالْخَرِيفُ الْحَدِيقَةُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates, “Rasulullah ﷺ ordered a Jama'ah to set out in the path of Allah Ta'ala.” “Ya
